title.narrative: Investing for Fight Against Tuberculosis

description.narrative: Myanmar - Tuberculosis - United Nations Office for Project Services - UNOPS. This program has the following goals: End the TB epidemic in Myanmar (Fewer than 10 cases per 100,000 population by 2035) 50% reduction of TB incidence compared with 2015 baseline by 2025. The objectives of this program are: Expand TB services as part of Universal Health Coverage and strengthen partnerships. Minimize TB transmission by intensifying efforts on prevention and reaching high-risk populations. Achieve a faster decline in TB burden through an accelerated multisectoral TB response.
